newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon construction activity stable in August.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon construction activity stable in August.

text.p: Construction activity was relatively stable in August, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin on Monday.
Construction had recovered somewhat in July with cement deliveries reaching 395,465 tonnes. In August they dropped slightly to 391,639 tonnes.
This compared with a fall in construction reported by the Bank in June.
August cement deliveries were 2.5 percent higher than the August 1995 total of 381,991 tonnes, the Bank said.
It said total real estate fees collected totalled 20.5 billion Lebanese pounds, a rise of 3.81 percent from the same period a year earlier.
